This presentation, a large T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesion without aggressive features, strongly argues against an IDH-wildtype glioma (glioblastoma), which typically demonstrates ring enhancement and central necrosis. The involvement of the insula ('Region Proportions') and deep gray matter structures including the caudate, putamen, and pallidum ('Anatomical Overlap Regions') is a classic feature of IDH-mutant astrocytomas (1p/19q non-codeleted). The deep white matter invasion further supports an astrocytic lineage.

overall_comment: A 44-year-old male with a large, non-enhancing, non-necrotic tumor involving the left insula, temporal lobe, and deep gray matter.
